About Atari

Atari is an interactive entertainment company and an iconic gaming industry brand recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises, including globally recognized brands such as Asteroids®, Centipede®, Missile Command®, Pong®, and RollerCoaster Tycoon®.

The Atari family of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Hipster Whale, Coatsink, Early Morning Studios, and Stormteller Games—spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide.

Atari operates internationally with offices in the US, UK, in France, Germany, Sweden, and India.

About the role

Münster, Germany · Part-time

The Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator will provide executive, administrative and project coordination support to the CFO. Based in Germany and working closely with the CFO in France, you will help keep financial administration, corporate governance and cross-border operational matters moving to completion.

This is a practical coordination role for someone who is organised, persistent and comfortable following up with banks, lawyers, tax advisers, notaries, corporate service providers and internal teams. You will coordinate documents, signatures, banking administration, KYC and AML requests, legal entity changes and board formalities across the Atari Group.

You do not need to be an accountant or a technical finance specialist. You do need to be reliable with sensitive information, comfortable with formal processes and willing to chase the right people until an item is complete.

What you’ll do

- Provide day-to-day executive and administrative support to the CFO, coordinating priorities across Germany, France and the US.
- Coordinate the preparation, circulation, approval and execution of corporate documents, board resolutions, powers of attorney and other legal or finance documentation.
- Manage signature workflows, monitor outstanding actions and ensure documents are signed, returned and stored on time.
- Coordinate banking administration, including account openings and closures, bank mandates, signatory updates and KYC/AML requests.
- Maintain accurate corporate records and legal entity documentation, ensuring information is complete, current and easy to retrieve.
- Support legal entity shutdowns, entity administration and related projects by coordinating actions across Finance, Legal, tax advisers, banks and external service providers.
- Liaise with banks, external legal counsel, tax lawyers, corporate service providers, notaries and local finance teams on administrative and corporate matters.
- Coordinate board minutes, governance records, approvals, formalities and other recurring corporate requirements.
- Support finance-related administrative work, including gathering information, tracking deadlines, maintaining records and coordinating deliverables.
- Act as a project coordinator for cross-functional finance and governance workstreams, keeping owners aligned and following through on open items.
- Provide administrative support for certain Luxembourg-related matters and coordinate with the relevant internal and external contacts.
- Escalate delays, missing information, unclear ownership or material issues to the CFO or relevant functional lead.

Requirements & Qualifications

- Professional fluency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally with internal and external stakeholders.
- Experience in an administrative, executive support, banking, legal operations, paralegal, corporate services or similar coordination role.
- Strong organisation and follow-through, with the confidence to chase people, manage deadlines and keep multiple workstreams moving.
- Experience handling confidential information and formal documentation with accuracy and discretion.
- Comfort working with banks, lawyers, advisers, notaries, corporate service providers or other external stakeholders.
- Ability to work independently, prioritise changing requests and operate with flexibility when the CFO and key stakeholders are based in another country.
- Good judgement and attention to detail when coordinating governance, KYC/AML, banking and legal entity administration.

Nice to have

- Professional proficiency in French.
- Experience supporting a CFO, finance leader, executive team or European corporate function.
- Experience in a bank, financial institution, law office, corporate services provider or multinational business.
- Familiarity with KYC/AML processes, bank mandates, signatory administration, powers of attorney, board documentation or legal entity management.
- Experience coordinating entity closures, corporate reorganisations, acquisitions or other cross-border projects.
- Familiarity with Luxembourg corporate or finance administration.

How you’ll work

This role is about making sure important administrative and governance work does not sit unresolved. You will often be coordinating several parties at once, clarifying what is needed, tracking who owns the next step and following up until the document, approval, bank request or entity action is complete.

You will work closely with Finance and Legal, but you are not expected to provide accounting or legal advice. Your value will come from being dependable, organised and persistent, and from creating enough structure that the CFO and specialist advisers can make decisions and complete formalities efficiently.

The role requires flexibility in working hours to accommodate cross-border coordination with the CFO in France, banks, advisers and teams in other time zones.

Why join Atari

This role sits at the centre of an international finance and governance environment. You will work across Germany, France, Luxembourg and other Atari Group locations, helping coordinate the formalities and projects that support the Group’s entities and operations.

You will have visibility across Finance, Legal and senior leadership, with the opportunity to build a reliable operating rhythm for corporate administration and cross-border coordination as Atari continues to integrate and develop its international business.

EEO Statement

Atari is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to equal employment regardless of race, religion or lack thereof, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, medical condition, veteran status, ancestry, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

Since our beginnings at Dr. Oetker, we have been breaking new ground. With pizza, cake, and desserts, as well as digital platforms and services - quality and an innovative spirit set us apart.

What awaits you? It's up to you! At Dr. Oetker, you can actively shape the future - both yours and ours. We want to be part of something bigger. Don't you?

JOIN THE TASTE.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- As an Application Product Owner - Innovation Management (m/f/d), you will support and develop the Clarity application. This involves analysing business requirements, developing suitable system solutions, and ensuring the application is user-friendly and business processes are mapped efficiently.
- Your responsibilities will include identifying and implementing opportunities to optimise existing processes and structures. In addition, you will contribute to application-related working groups and projects.
- You will coordinate rollouts, system changes, and new functionalities. Furthermore, you will advise and support users on business-related topics and resolve application issues by developing appropriate solutions.
- You will also be responsible for creating and maintaining training materials, system documentation, and user guides, as well as conducting training sessions and workshops.
- Working closely with the IT and Application Management teams, as well as external service providers, you will gather, analyse, and document business requirements. You will prioritize enhancement requests, create functional concepts and test cases, and support business testing activities as well as the implementation of new functionalities.
- With a focus on data quality and reporting, you will support business departments in maintaining high standards of data quality. You will analyse data, create standard reports and dashboards, identify data inconsistencies, and contribute to the further development of reporting and analytics capabilities.
- In collaboration with various business functions, IT, and other stakeholders, you will help ensure the efficient use of systems, identify and implement improvement measures, and contribute ideas for the further development of existing processes and applications. You will also actively participate in cross-functional projects.

WHAT YOU BRING

- You have successfully completed a degree in Business Informatics, Business Administration, Innovation Management, or a related subject with a focus on IT applications, business processes, project management, or digital solutions.
- You have several years of professional experience in Application Management, Product Ownership, Project Management, or a comparable role focused on the support and continuous improvement of business applications.
- Ideally, you have knowledge of project and portfolio management, as well as experience with Clarity or similar applications. In addition, you are familiar with innovation management processes, such as Idea2Launch, Stage-Gate-processes, or similar frameworks.
- You are proficient in agile, hybrid and demand management methodologies, including backlog prioritisation, release planning, and value-driven product development. You are experienced in developing product visions and roadmaps and translating business strategies into scalable system solutions, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
- You have a strong affinity for data governance, portfolio transparency, reporting analytics, and data-driven decision-making. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills distinguish you.
- You think strategically, analytically, and commercially, and work a in structured, pragmatic, and solution-oriented manner. Furthermore, you have a proven ability to prioritise competing requirements effectively, derive sound business cases and make recommendations.
- Excellent German and English language skills would complete your profile.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

- Attractive remuneration
- Flexible work models & mobile work
- 30 days of vacation plus Special vacation at Christmas & New Year's Eve
- Onboarding and professional development opportunities
- Excellent employee restaurant and discounts in the Dr. Oetker Shop
- Events and celebrations ​
- Sports, health and fitness offers
- Pension plan, Sabbatical and JobRad
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP), this offers professional support in all situations, such as assistance with childcare, finding au pairs, and advice on care services
- Daycare cooperation for children, holiday childcare and laundry service

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
The Position
Are you passionate about cardiovascular science and dedicated to ensuring patient health and safety? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!
Our CRM team is seeking an experienced Lead Patient Safety Physician with expertise in cardiovascular, renal, and/or metabolic diseases. In this pivotal role, you will contribute to one of Boehringer Ingelheim's priority assets in late-stage clinical development, making a meaningful impact on patient safety worldwide.
This position can be filled in Ingelheim or Biberach.
Tasks & responsibilities

- Lead, manage, and provide medical-scientific direction to a team of Patient Safety Physicians responsible for a compound/asset, including project management, project-specific guidance, team coaching, and review of team output
- Play a key role in global regulatory submissions across all regions
- Develop proactive patient-centric risk minimization strategies for assigned assets on a global scale
- Enhance the value of BI assets through robust assessment of the benefit-risk profile
- Design evidence strategies that differentiate the asset through its benefit-risk profile, considering the scientific knowledge for the molecule, medical safety landscape, population, regulatory landscape, and patient perspective
- Generate safety evidence and perform safety & efficacy analyses to support decision-making by patients, regulators, HCPs, payors, and HTA bodies
- Ensure patient safety while adhering to the highest quality and ethical standards

Requirements

- Medical Doctor with strong clinical and/or clinical research experience
- Profound experience in patient safety at a pharmaceutical company on a global/corporate level, including clinical development and post-marketing safety
- Comprehensive understanding of pharmacovigilance regulations in major markets and the need for compliance
- Broad knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry, and interest in future trends and developments in pharmacovigilance
- Clinical or research experience in the cardio-renal-metabolic field
- Proven leadership, people management & project management skills
- Excellent collaboration, communication, and negotiation skills
- Strong ethical sense with a quality and patient centricity mindset
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
Ready to contact us? 
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until October 30th. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to September 15th are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the month of August/ beginning of September
Step 3: Panel interviews in the beginning of the month September

Site Manager / Superintendent Mechanical Engineering / Plant Construction (m/f/d) in Olfen

Since the company was founded in 1989, OLKO-Maschinentechnik GmbH has been one of the driving forces in the shaft sinking and hoisting technology segment. As a 100% subsidiary of the THYSSEN SCHACHTBAU Group, we are at home in the relevant international markets and supply innovations from the cradle of mining all over the world.

What sets us apart is that we don't do things by halves: OLKO-Maschinentechnik GmbH stands for pioneering system solutions with a high degree of vertical integration and components developed and often patented in-house.

For our locations in 59399 Olfen and worldwide, we are looking as soon as possible to recruit a qualified

Site Manager / Superintendent Mechanical Engineering / Plant Construction (m/f/d)

Your tasks:

• Independent construction management of assembly projects

• Technical and organizational responsibility on the construction site

• Supporting the project manager directly on site at the customer's premises

• Work preparation and coordination of subcontractors

• Creation of assembly documentation

• Conducting construction meetings, instructions, customer inspections and customer acceptance tests

• Helping to achieve the project goals in terms of deadlines, quality and costs

Our requirements:

• Experience as site manager/supervisor or

• Experience as a foreman with the desire to develop into a site manager in the future

• Completed technical training in the field of mechanical engineering

The Chair of Glass Chemistry seeks to fill the position of a
Doctoral research position
in the field of mechanoluminescent materials

commencing on January 1st, 2027, offered as fixed-term position for an initial period of 36 months according to TV-L E13 (75%).

Mechanoluminescence (ML) is the fascinating phenomenon where a material emits light in response to mechanical stimuli, such as scratching, compression, or impact. By translating mechanical stress directly into a visible, infrared, or ultraviolet optical response, ML opens up a plethora of groundbreaking applications. These range from real-time damage monitoring in advanced structural materials to biophysical stress analysis and the visualization of acoustic waves.

Despite its immense potential, the field of mechanoluminescence is still in its infancy. There is a critical gap both in the versatility of practical material solutions and in our fundamental understanding of the underlying physical and chemical mechanisms. This Ph.D. project aims to tackle these challenges, investigating how next-generation inorganic mechanoluminescent materials must be designed and synthesized to meet the stringent demands of future applications.
Design and synthesis of novel inorganic mechanoluminescent materials (e.g., solid-state synthesis, sol-gel processes, or melt-based routes).
Structural and optical characterization using advanced techniques (e.g., XRD, SEM, photoluminescence, and decay spectroscopy).
Mechanoluminescent testing utilizing custom-built setups to evaluate material responses under various mechanical loads (compression, friction, impact).
Fundamental investigation of the charge-trapping and detrapping mechanisms that govern stress-induced light emission.
Collaboration with internal and external partners to explore application-oriented device integration.
Publication of research results in high-impact scientific journals and presentation at international conferences.

Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics, or a closely related discipline.
Strong background or keen interest in solid-state chemistry, luminescence, or smart materials.
Hands-on experience with material synthesis and standard characterization techniques is highly desirable.
High level of motivation, curiosity, and the ability to work both independently and as part of an international team.
Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken); knowledge of German is an asset but not mandatory.

A cutting-edge research project at the forefront of materials science.

A vibrant, international, and interdisciplinary research environment.
